name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 12 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.79 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
